problem: A classroom wall has 26 paintings pinned up. Mr Haddad pins 8 more of the children's paintings next to them. How many paintings are on the wall now?
follow_up_questions: He takes down 4 paintings that have torn corners. How many paintings remain on the wall?
He then puts the paintings into folders, 5 in each folder. How many folders does he fill?

problem: How many keys hang on the board in the hotel lobby now, if it held 26 keys and the receptionist has just hung up 8 more?
follow_up_questions: Guests check in and collect 4 of the keys. How many keys are still hanging on the board?
The night porter puts the remaining keys on rings, 5 keys to a ring. How many rings does he need?

problem: At the start of the morning, 5 swimmers were in the pool. More came for the noon class, and then the pool had 13 swimmers. The lifeguard, Omar, has worked there for 9 years. How many swimmers came for the noon class?
follow_up_questions: Then 3 coaches walk in to watch. How many swimmers and coaches are at the pool now?

problem: The chess club room had 13 players by the end of the day, but only 5 had been there at lunch. Ms Novak's oldest chess board is 9 years old. Find how many players came after lunch.
follow_up_questions: Later, 3 teachers drop in to watch the games. How many players and teachers are in the room now?

problem: Kaito put 6 new helmets on the bike shed shelf, and now the shelf has 15. The new helmets are shiny and red. How many helmets were on the shelf before?
follow_up_questions: The bike club has 18 riders. How many more helmets does the club need so that each rider can wear one?
Kaito buys those helmets and 2 extra ones in case any break. How many helmets does he buy?

problem: How many lunch boxes were in the cupboard before Mrs Patel added her 6 new ones? After she put them in, the cupboard held 15. The new boxes have little cartoon cats on the lids.
follow_up_questions: There are 18 children in the cooking class. How many more lunch boxes are needed for every child to have one?
Mrs Patel orders that number of boxes and 2 spare ones. How many lunch boxes does she order?

problem: A school library had 56 comic books. A parent dropped off a box with 37 more. How many comic books does the library have now?
Find the number of jars on the pantry shelves after Grandpa unpacks 37 jars of honey next to the 56 jars already there.
A fish tank had 12 litres of water in it. Priya added more water, and her brother said that altogether there were 20 litres now. How many litres did Priya add?
follow_up_questions: Over the summer, 9 litres of water dry up. How many litres are left in the tank?

problem: How many bags of sand did the caretaker tip into the sandpit? The pit had 12 bags before, and together there are now 20 bags in it.
follow_up_questions: Heavy rain washes away 9 bags of sand. How many bags are left in the pit?

problem: Mr Silva brings 14 jars of jam into his shop and puts them on one of its 3 shelves, beside the jam that was already there. That shelf now holds 32 jars of jam. How many jars were on it before?
follow_up_questions: He sells 10 jars to a cafe. How many jars of jam are left?
Then he makes 8 more jars. How many jars of jam does he have now?
He packs the jars in boxes that hold 5 each. How many boxes does he need?

problem: There are 32 toy cars on the top tray of Leo's toy chest, which has 3 trays. Earlier today he added 14 cars that he got for his birthday. Before his birthday, how many toy cars were on the top tray?
follow_up_questions: Leo gives 10 cars to his cousin. How many toy cars are left on the tray?
His aunt gives him 8 more cars. How many toy cars are on the tray now?
He parks them in rows of 5. How many rows does he make?

problem: Before the holidays, the class shelf held 49 books. During the holidays, Amelia brought in all 34 books from her old bookcase. How many books are on the class shelf now?
follow_up_questions: The teacher sends 25 of the books home with the children to read. How many books stay on the shelf?
The school librarian brings 19 more books. How many books are on the shelf now?

problem: Work out how many shells are in the museum drawer now. It already had 49 shells, and a diver named Tavita just added the 34 she found on the reef.
follow_up_questions: The museum lends 25 shells to a school. How many shells are left in the drawer?
A collector donates 19 more shells. How many shells are in the drawer now?

problem: Ayaan had 9 marbles in his jar. After a trip to the toy shop he dropped his new marbles in, and the jar now holds 16. How many marbles did Ayaan buy?
follow_up_questions: He gives 3 marbles to his friend Noor. How many marbles are left in the jar?

problem: The bird feeder had 9 sparrows on it. A whole flock swooped down, and now Mum counts 16 sparrows there. How many sparrows came with the flock?
follow_up_questions: A cat creeps by and 3 sparrows fly away. How many sparrows stay on the feeder?

problem: Hana pours 8 goldfish into the school pond. Afterwards she counts 23 goldfish swimming there. The pond has lily pads with white flowers. How many goldfish were in the pond before Hana added hers?
Dev counted 23 snails in the vegetable bed after he set free the 8 snails from his jar there. Dev likes rainy days best. Find how many snails were in the bed before he set his free.
A bakery has 66 bread rolls on its racks. The baker brings in 27 more rolls, baked in 4 big ovens. How many bread rolls are on the racks now?
follow_up_questions: Customers buy 48 rolls. How many rolls remain?
The baker puts the remaining rolls into bags of 9. How many bags does he fill?

problem: Kemal adds 27 new stickers to his album, which already had 66. He bought them at 4 different shops. What is the total number of stickers in his album now?
follow_up_questions: He trades away 48 stickers. How many does he have left?
He sorts the rest into piles of 9. How many piles are there?

problem: Ms Achebe added 12 new books to the class library and told the class that there were now 40 books altogether. How many books were in the class library before?
follow_up_questions: Rain leaks through the window and spoils 4 books, so she throws them away. How many books are left?
She buys 9 new books. How many books are in the class library now?
She lines them up on shelves, 5 on each shelf. How many shelves does she fill?

problem: What number of chickens were in the coop before Farmer Ruiz put in his 12 new hens? Afterwards he counted 40 chickens altogether.
follow_up_questions: He sells 4 chickens to a neighbour. How many chickens are left?
He buys 9 more chickens. How many chickens are in the coop now?
He builds nesting boxes, with 5 chickens sharing each box. How many boxes does he need?

problem: Tomasz counted 13 ducks on the pond. When he scattered some bread, 7 more ducks swam over. How many ducks are on the pond now?
follow_up_questions: A dog barks, and half of the ducks fly off. How many ducks are still on the pond?

problem: How many children are dancing in the school hall now? There were 13 practising a dance when 7 more came in after the bell.
follow_up_questions: Then half of the dancers leave for their music lesson. How many children are still dancing?

problem: Aunt Rosa keeps a jar of buttons. Before the market she had 58 shiny buttons, and now she has 85. Her button jar is 20 years old. At the market, how many shiny buttons did she get?
follow_up_questions: She gives 15 of her shiny buttons to her niece. How many shiny buttons does Aunt Rosa have left?
Her niece already had 23 buttons. How many buttons does the niece have now?

problem: How many seashells did Kofi find on holiday? He had 58 shells in his box before he left and 85 when he got home. The beach was a 20-minute walk from the hotel.
follow_up_questions: Kofi gives 15 of the shells to his cousin. How many shells does Kofi have left?
His cousin had 23 shells before. How many shells does his cousin have now?

problem: Each time she finishes a puzzle, Zara adds a gold star to her chart. This month she earned 11 stars, and the chart now has 30. How many stars were on the chart before this month?
Before this month, how many coins were in Matteo's piggy bank? He put in 11 coins this month, and now there are 30 coins inside.
Mira already has 27 shells in her shoebox. At the beach she picks up 8 more. The beach was very windy that day. How many shells does Mira have now?
follow_up_questions: For her birthday, her uncle gives her 5 more shells. How many shells does Mira have then?

problem: Yusuf already keeps 27 football cards in a tin at home. Today he bought 8 new ones at the corner shop. The shop smelled of chocolate. What is the total number of football cards he owns now?
follow_up_questions: His grandad gives him 5 more cards. How many football cards does Yusuf have then?

problem: Ella was sure she had lost her bag of 6 hair clips, but it turned up in her coat pocket. She put them in her box with the 19 clips already inside. How many hair clips are in the box now?
follow_up_questions: She swaps 4 of them for one big sparkly clip. How many clips are in her box after the swap?

problem: How many crayons are in Luis's pencil case now? He thought his packet of 6 crayons had gone missing, but he found it in his desk and tipped them into the case with the 19 crayons there.
follow_up_questions: He trades 4 of his crayons for one giant gold crayon. How many crayons are in his pencil case after the trade?

problem: After a visit to the bookshop, Sven had 93 books on his shelves. Before the visit he had 64. How many books did he bring home?
Ruth had 64 beads in her craft box before going to the bead market. Now the box has 93 beads. Find how many beads she bought at the market.
The class was collecting bottle caps for an art project. On Monday the children brought in 12 caps, and the collection jar now holds 29. How many caps were in the jar before Monday?
follow_up_questions: On Thursday 9 more caps are added. How many caps are in the jar now?
The children split the caps evenly between 2 mosaics. How many caps does each mosaic get?

problem: There are 29 pine cones in the nature box now, after the children added the 12 they gathered on a walk. How many pine cones were in the box before the walk?
follow_up_questions: A teacher adds 9 more pine cones. What is the number of pine cones in the box now?
The cones are shared equally between 2 groups for a craft. How many pine cones does each group get?

problem: Mia stands on the dock and sees 15 boats already sailing on the lake. Soon 9 more boats set out. Mia's rowing boat is 3 metres long. How many boats are sailing now?
follow_up_questions: When a storm comes, 6 boats return to the dock. How many are still sailing?

problem: How many balloons are floating above the fair now? At first 15 hot-air balloons were up, then 9 more rose into the sky. Each basket can carry 3 people.
follow_up_questions: As the sun sets, 6 balloons land. How many balloons are still floating?

problem: Mr Owusu's 8 sailboats are not alone on the bay any more: 21 sailboats are now on the water. Seagulls cry overhead. How many of the sailboats belong to other people?
follow_up_questions: Each of Mr Owusu's sailboats has 2 sails. How many sails do his boats have?
Mr Owusu ordered 20 sails for his boats. After fitting all the sails, how many are left over?

problem: This morning the cycling club parked its 8 bikes in the school rack. By lunchtime the rack held 21 bikes. The rack is next to the gym door. How many of those bikes belong to people outside the club?
follow_up_questions: Each club bike has 2 lights. How many lights are on the club's bikes?
The club bought 20 lights. How many lights are left over?

problem: The baker sets out another 35 muffins on the counter and tells a customer that 72 muffins are now for sale. How many muffins were on the counter before?
Before the shopkeeper unpacked a box of 35 caps, how many caps were on the rack? Now there are seventy-two caps for sale.
The farmers' market opened at 10 o'clock with 14 stalls set up. By noon there were 30 stalls. How many stalls were set up after the opening?
follow_up_questions: At noon, 7 stallholders pack up and leave. How many stalls are still open?
Then 12 more stalls open for the afternoon. How many stalls are open now?
The organiser groups the stalls into rows of 5. How many rows are there?

problem: How many swimmers came after opening time, if the pool had 14 swimmers when it opened and 30 by midday? The pool has 10 lanes.
follow_up_questions: At midday, 7 swimmers leave for lunch. How many are still in the pool?
Then 12 more swimmers arrive for the afternoon races. How many swimmers are in the pool now?
For the races, the swimmers form teams of 5. How many teams are there?

problem: The school had some recorders ready for music class. After a music shop donated 26 more, there were 61 recorders. How many recorders were ready before the donation?
follow_up_questions: There are 75 pupils in the school. How many more recorders are needed so every pupil has one?
The music teacher buys those recorders for 3 dollars each. How many dollars does she spend?

problem: Find how many sleeping bags the camp had before the scouts brought 26 more, which made 61 in total.
follow_up_questions: The camp is expecting 75 campers. How many more sleeping bags are needed so each camper has one?
The leader buys them for 3 dollars each. What is the total cost in dollars?

problem: Rahel has painted 6 masks for the school play. She tells Jonas that if they paint 8 more tonight, everyone in the play will have one. If they do, how many masks will they have?
follow_up_questions: Each mask needs 3 feathers. How many feathers do they need for all the masks?

problem: How many paper lanterns will there be, if Chen and his sister make 8 more lanterns tomorrow to add to the 6 they have already made?
follow_up_questions: Every lantern needs 3 candles. How many candles do they need for all of them?

problem: This morning there were 9 frisbees stuck on the school roof, and now the caretaker counts 17. He grumbles and climbs into his van. How many more frisbees landed on the roof?
How many more cars had parked by lunch? At breakfast time 9 cars stood in the car park of the swimming pool, and by lunch there were 17. A seagull sat on one of the car roofs.
The coach says the team needs more jerseys, so he brings 9 from his car and adds them to the 21 in the kit bag. How many jerseys are in the kit bag now?
follow_up_questions: The team has 34 players. How many more jerseys are needed so each player gets one?

problem: There were 21 paint brushes in the art room jar. The art teacher brought 9 more from her house. What is the total number of brushes in the jar now?
follow_up_questions: The art class has 34 pupils. How many more brushes are needed so every pupil has one?

problem: The dress-up basket in the classroom held 12 scarves. The children added scarves they brought from home, and Nia counted a total of 27. How many scarves did the children bring?
follow_up_questions: The teacher takes 6 scarves out for a dance game. How many scarves are still in the basket?
After the game, 4 of those scarves are put back. How many scarves are in the basket now?
How many scarves are still out of the basket?

problem: How many paint pots did the art club bring? The cupboard had 12 pots, and once the club put theirs in, Sam counted a total of 27.
follow_up_questions: The art teacher lifts out 6 pots for today's lesson. How many paint pots remain in the cupboard?
At the end of the lesson, 4 of those pots go back in. How many pots does the cupboard hold now?
How many paint pots are still on the art tables?

problem: In the last round of the relay, 7 more runners came onto the track, and now 19 runners are racing. How many runners were racing before the last round?
follow_up_questions: The coach set out 25 medals, and each runner gets one. How many medals are not handed out?

problem: Before the final dance, how many children were on the dance floor? Then 7 more children ran on to join in, making 19 dancers.
follow_up_questions: A parent made 25 flower crowns, and every dancer wears one. How many crowns are not being worn?

problem: Mr Batbayar's toy train set once had 14 wagons. He has been building new ones in his workshop, and now the set has 22. How many new wagons has he built?
How many new quilts has Granny Weng finished? Her cupboard held 14 quilts before she started sewing, and now it holds 22.

After the match, fans give the goalkeeper 11 scarves, and she puts them in her locker with the scarves already there. Now her locker holds 26 scarves. The crowd is still singing. How many scarves were in the locker before?
follow_up_questions: She gives 6 scarves to her coach. How many scarves are left in the locker?

problem: Lucia's teacher kept a cup of pencils on her desk. On her birthday the class gave her 11 new pencils, and the cup then held 26. The classroom was decorated with paper flowers. Work out how many pencils were in the cup before her birthday.
follow_up_questions: She lends 6 pencils to the class next door. How many pencils are left in the cup?

problem: A restaurant laid 45 places for a wedding dinner. When more guests replied yes, the waiters laid another 39. How many places are laid now?
follow_up_questions: On the night, 76 places have a guest sitting at them. How many places are empty?
Then 5 more guests arrive late and sit down. How many places are empty now?

problem: Find the number of tents at the festival now. On Friday 45 tents were put up, and on Saturday 39 more.
follow_up_questions: Campers sleep in 76 of the tents. How many tents are empty?
Then 5 late campers each take one of the empty tents. How many tents are empty now?

problem: Ranger Ama sees 8 deer in the meadow. By sunset more deer have wandered in from the forest, and she counts 20. How many deer came from the forest?
follow_up_questions: The next spring 5 fawns are born. How many deer and fawns are in the meadow now?
Then 9 of them move on to another valley. How many are left in the meadow?
The rest split into 2 herds of the same size. How many animals are in each herd?

problem: How many ducks did Farmer Li fetch from the river? She saw 8 ducks in the yard, and after she brought the others home there were 20.
follow_up_questions: Then 5 ducklings hatch. How many ducks and ducklings are in the yard now?
She sells 9 of them at the market. How many stay in the yard?
She puts the rest in 2 sheds, the same number in each. How many go in each shed?

problem: This summer 9 kittens were born at the animal shelter. Together with the cats already living there, the shelter now has 24 cats. How many cats were at the shelter before the kittens arrived?
follow_up_questions: The shelter takes in 6 more cats. How many cats live there now?

problem: How many hens were in the hen house before 9 chicks hatched this spring? Together, the hens and the new chicks now number 24.
follow_up_questions: The farmer buys 6 more hens. How many birds are in the hen house now?

problem: Maya has written 13 thank-you cards. She says she will stop when she has 30. How many more cards must she write?
follow_up_questions: She puts all her cards into 3 envelopes, the same number in each. How many cards go in each envelope?
She hands one envelope to her teacher. How many cards does she have left?

problem: Joon wants 30 pebbles for his garden path. He already has 13 in a bucket. How many more pebbles must he collect?
follow_up_questions: He spreads all the pebbles across 3 flower beds, the same number in each. How many pebbles go in each bed?
His sister takes the pebbles from one bed for her fish tank. How many pebbles does Joon have left?

problem: Hamza rushes into class with news: last night 6 puppies were born at his family's kennel, so now it has 17 dogs. The kennel has 2 big gates. How many dogs did the kennel have before the puppies came?
follow_up_questions: Next month the family takes in 4 more dogs. How many dogs will be in the kennel then?

problem: How many rabbits were in the hutch before the babies arrived? Six baby rabbits were born this morning, and now 17 rabbits live there. Lena feeds them 2 times each day.
follow_up_questions: Next week Lena's dad brings home 4 more rabbits. How many rabbits will live in the hutch then?

problem: At the book sale, a teacher bought books to add to her class library of 37. On the bus home she works out that the library will now have 62 books. How many books did she buy?
Find how many fish Mr Kowalski bought for his pond. His pond had 37 fish, and now it has 62.
Some children were playing in the sandpit when 8 more ran over from the swings. Ravi added them all up and got 21 children. How many children were in the sandpit before?
follow_up_questions: Later 5 children go home. How many children are left in the sandpit?

problem: How many frogs were sitting on the log at first? Then 8 more hopped up out of the water, and Ines added them all up to get 21 frogs.
follow_up_questions: A heron lands nearby and 5 frogs jump back into the water. How many frogs are left on the log?

problem: The toy shop owner unpacks a box of 12 teddy bears and sets them on the shelf beside the 24 already there. The box had travelled 9 days by ship. How many teddy bears are on the shelf now?
follow_up_questions: Children carry 15 of the bears to the play corner. How many bears are still on the shelf?
Later 8 bears are put back on the shelf. How many teddy bears are on the shelf now?
How many of the bears are still in the play corner?

problem: How many board games are in the games cupboard after the club leader adds a donated set of 12 to the 24 already inside? The donation came from 9 families.
follow_up_questions: Members take out 15 games to play. How many games are still in the cupboard?
Later 8 games are put away again. How many board games are in the cupboard now?
How many games are still out on the tables?

problem: On Monday the sign-up sheet for the school choir had 38 names. By Friday Ms Oduya sees that it has 84. How many children signed up during the week?
follow_up_questions: Ms Oduya has 90 song books and hands one to every child on the sheet. How many song books are left?
She orders 25 more song books. How many will she have then?

problem: How many runners entered the fun run between Monday and Friday? On Monday the entry list showed 38 runners, and on Friday it showed 84.
follow_up_questions: The organiser has 90 T-shirts and gives one to each runner on the list. How many T-shirts are left?
She orders 25 more T-shirts. How many T-shirts will she have then?

problem: When the postman empties the post box at the end of the day, he finds 25 letters. A shopkeeper told him that 9 of them were posted after lunch. How many letters were in the box before lunch?
follow_up_questions: He sends 13 of the letters to the city and the rest to the villages. How many letters go to the villages?

problem: A lost-and-found bin had 25 items in it by evening. Of these, 9 were handed in after lunch. Before lunch, how many items were in the bin?
follow_up_questions: The office returns 13 of the items to their owners, and the rest are given to charity. How many items go to charity?

problem: The class hamster cage had 8 hamsters, and this morning Mr Dube added 5 more. The cage has a blue running wheel. How many hamsters live in the cage now?
A first grader asks Mrs Kahale how many birds live in the school aviary now. It had 8 finches, and today she let in 5 more. The aviary has a small wooden swing. Work out the answer for her.
A team is coming for lunch, so the cook carries 6 extra stools to the long table. Now 24 stools stand there. How many stools were at the table at first?
follow_up_questions: Only 21 players sit down. How many stools are empty?

problem: There are 24 cushions on the reading rug now, after the teacher added 6 more for a big story session. How many cushions were on the rug before she added them?
follow_up_questions: Just 21 children turn up. How many cushions are left with nobody sitting on them?

problem: The art teacher says the room has fewer red crayons than blue ones, only 30. Then a box of 14 new red crayons arrives. How many red crayons does the art room have now?
follow_up_questions: There are 50 blue crayons. How many more blue crayons than red crayons are there now?
The teacher orders 9 more red crayons. How many red crayons will there be then?
Then how many more red crayons than blue crayons will there be?

problem: How many football stickers does Pedro own now? He has fewer football stickers than animal stickers, just 30, but today he got a pack of 14 more football ones.
follow_up_questions: Pedro has 50 animal stickers. How many more animal stickers than football stickers does he have now?
His uncle gives him 9 more football stickers. How many football stickers will he have then?
Then how many more football stickers than animal stickers will Pedro have?

problem: When the snow began to fall, shoppers hurried into the cafe. Before the snow there were 7 people inside; afterwards there were 19. How many came in because of the snow?
follow_up_questions: When the snow stops, 11 people leave to finish their shopping. How many stay in the cafe?

problem: How many children ran into the gym when the thunder started? There had been 7 children in the gym, and once the storm began there were 19.
follow_up_questions: After the storm passes, 11 children go back outside. How many stay in the gym?

problem: Coach Svensson checks the team sheet. Since the summer break the team has won 26 points, and its total for the year is 72. The club bus has 11 rows of seats. How many points had the team won before the break?
follow_up_questions: In the next game they win 4 points. What is their total for the year now?
The top team has 90 points this year. How many fewer points does Coach Svensson's team have?

problem: How many baskets had the netball team scored before the holidays? Its season total is 72, and 26 of those baskets came after the holidays. The team has 11 players on its list.
follow_up_questions: In the next match they score 4 baskets. What is their season total now?
Their rivals have scored 90 baskets this season. How many fewer baskets has the netball team scored?

problem: The gardener fills 7 new watering cans and lines them up beside the 18 already in the shed. How many watering cans are in the shed now?
Count the paintbrushes in the jar: there were 18 in it, and Ms Haddad has just washed 7 new ones and dropped them in. What is the total?
Just 23 people were in the cinema when the film started. By the middle of the film there were 40, Ravi noticed. The popcorn was salty. How many people came in after the film started?
follow_up_questions: In the second half of the film, 15 more people arrive. How many people are in the cinema at the end?

problem: How many parents arrived at the school concert after it began? When the first song started, 23 parents were in their seats, and by the interval there were 40. The stage curtains were dark red.
follow_up_questions: After the interval, 15 more parents came in. How many parents were at the concert at the end?

problem: The chess club's open day brought in 29 new players. The club now has 74 players. How many players did the club have before the open day?
follow_up_questions: Next year the club hopes to have 90 players. How many more players does it need?
If 8 of those join in the spring, how many more will still be needed?

problem: A choir has 74 singers now, after a concert drew in 29 new singers. What was the size of the choir before the concert?
follow_up_questions: The choir leader wants 90 singers by next summer. How many more singers does she need?
Suppose 8 of them sign up in the autumn. How many more singers will still be needed?

problem: Before the race, a volunteer sees that the drinks table has only 12 cups of juice, so she pours another 15. How many cups of juice are on the table now?
follow_up_questions: The runners drink 20 cups during the race. How many cups are left?
After the race, the volunteer pours 8 more cups. How many cups are on the table now?
The 3 volunteers share all of that juice equally. How many cups does each volunteer get?

problem: How many litres of water are in the paddling pool now, if it had 12 litres and Dad tipped in another 15?
follow_up_questions: The children splash 20 litres out of the pool. How many litres are left?
Dad adds 8 more litres with the hose. How many litres are in the pool now?
At the end of the day, Dad empties the water equally onto 3 flower beds. How many litres does each bed get?

problem: Ms Farah puts out 32 more paper cups for the school fair. Now she counts 70 cups on the tables. How many cups were already on the tables before?
How many hurdles were on the track before the coach set out 32 more? After he did, there were 70.
During the break a teacher carries a plate of 16 biscuits to the staff room, where 20 biscuits are already waiting. How many biscuits are in the staff room now?
follow_up_questions: The 12 teachers eat 2 biscuits each. How many biscuits are left?
The 4 cleaners share the rest equally. How many biscuits does each cleaner get?

problem: How many grapes are in the fruit bowl now? It held 20 grapes, and Abuela has just added a bunch of 16.
follow_up_questions: Each of the 12 cousins eats 2 grapes. How many grapes are left?
The last grapes are shared equally by 4 aunts. How many grapes does each aunt get?

problem: The music room had 14 tambourines in the cupboard, and a parent donated 9 more. How many tambourines are in the cupboard now?
follow_up_questions: The music teacher takes 6 tambourines to the hall for a concert. How many are still in the cupboard?
After the concert, 4 tambourines are returned. How many tambourines does the cupboard hold now?

problem: Find how many skipping ropes the PE shed has after the class adds the 9 ropes it collected to the 14 ropes already there.
follow_up_questions: During break, children borrow 6 ropes for the playground. How many ropes are left in the shed?
When the bell rings, 4 ropes are brought back. How many ropes are in the shed now?

problem: In a spelling bee, the Blue team had 38 points after the first round. By the end of the second round, its score was 71. How many points did the Blue team earn in the second round?
follow_up_questions: The Red team earned 29 points in the second round. How many more second-round points did the Blue team earn than the Red team?
The Blue team won the contest by 15 points. What was the Red team's final score?

problem: What did the Rockets score in the second half of their basketball game? Their final score was 71, and they had 38 points at half-time.
follow_up_questions: The Comets scored 29 points in the second half. How many more points did the Rockets score than the Comets in that half?
Overall, the Rockets won the game by 15 points. How many points did the Comets score in all?

problem: A few friends were building a snowman in the yard. Their noses were red from the cold. Then 5 more friends came to help, and now 14 are building it. How many friends were building the snowman at first?
follow_up_questions: They split into two equal teams for a snowball fight. How many friends are on each team?
Then 3 players from one team go inside to warm up. How many players are left on that team?

problem: How many children were playing tag on the beach at the start? After 5 more joined in, 14 children were playing. The waves were loud that day.
follow_up_questions: The children make two equal teams. How many are on each team?
Then 3 children from one team leave to eat ice cream. How many children are left on that team?

problem: Chef Moreau put 16 plates on the long table before dinner. A waiter brought 8 more from the kitchen. The plates had gold edges. How many plates were on the table then?
How many towels were on the shelf by the pool after the lifeguard added 8 to the 16 already folded there? The towels were striped green and white.
Omar read 7 pages of his book on Monday. By the end of Tuesday, he had read 15 pages over the two days. How many pages did he read on Tuesday?
follow_up_questions: On Wednesday he read 6 more pages. How many pages has he read over the three days?

problem: Hina scored 7 goals in her first football match of the tournament. After her second match, she had 15 goals in total. How many goals did she score in the second match?
follow_up_questions: In her third match she scored 6 goals. What is her total for the tournament so far?

problem: Some people were waiting at the bus stop. Then 12 more people arrived, and there were 30 people at the stop. How many people were waiting at first?
How many cars were in the car park before 12 more drove in? After they arrived, the car park held 30 cars.
Bea left the spelling contest at the break with 12 words right. She came back and spelled 9 more words right. How many words did Bea spell right in the whole contest?
follow_up_questions: Her friend Lin spelled 5 fewer words right than Bea. How many words did Lin spell right?

problem: What was Tariq's total in the darts game? He left for lunch with 12 points and then came back to score 9 more.
follow_up_questions: His brother scored 5 fewer points than Tariq. How many points did his brother score?

problem: There are 9 bikes in the bike shed. How many more bikes must the club bring in to fill it with 20?
follow_up_questions: Each bike takes 2 minutes to oil. How many minutes will it take to oil every bike in the full shed?
The club has already spent 10 minutes oiling. How many more minutes are needed?

problem: The sand table needs 20 buckets of sand to be full. If 9 buckets are already in it, how many more must the teacher pour in?
follow_up_questions: It takes 2 minutes to fill each bucket. How many minutes does it take to fill every bucket that the full table needs?
The teacher has already been filling buckets for 10 minutes. How many more minutes are needed?

problem: At the fair Lucas was given 6 stickers, and now he owns 17. He can't recall how many he owned before the fair. Can you work it out?
follow_up_questions: He gives 4 stickers to his little sister. How many stickers does he have now?
Then he buys a sheet of 5 stickers. How many stickers does he have after that?

problem: How many marbles were in Freya's bag before the school sports day? She won 6 marbles there and now has 17.
follow_up_questions: She loses 4 marbles through a hole in the bag. How many marbles does she have now?
Then her friend gives her 5 marbles. How many marbles does she have after that?

problem: The chess club had 47 members in January. During February, 26 new members joined. How many members did the club have at the end of February?
At the end of the summer, how many books were on Mrs Ito's shelf? It held 47 books in June, and she bought 26 more over the summer.
At first 8 children were bouncing on the bouncy castle, but soon the number grew to 15. How many children got on after the first ones?
follow_up_questions: The attendant blew a whistle, and 6 children climbed off. How many children are still on the castle?
After that, a group of 3 friends jumps on. How many children are on the castle now?

problem: How many people joined the queue at the ice cream van, if the queue had 8 people and then grew to 15?
follow_up_questions: The van served 6 people, and they left the queue. How many people are still waiting?
Then 3 more people joined the end of the queue. How many people are in the queue now?

problem: A librarian added 10 new magazines to the pile on the reading table, and then the pile had 18 magazines. How many magazines were in the pile before she added the new ones?
follow_up_questions: Readers took 7 magazines from the pile. How many magazines are left?

problem: How many plates were on the shelf before the cook put back 10 clean plates? After she did, the shelf held 18 plates.
follow_up_questions: Diners took 7 plates from the shelf. How many plates are left?

problem: Mila had cycled 12 laps around the school yard when her dad told her to do 9 more. How many laps will she have cycled altogether?
follow_up_questions: Each lap of the school yard is 25 metres. How far will Mila have cycled, in metres?
Her brother cycled 4 fewer laps than Mila. How many laps did he cycle?
How many laps did Mila and her brother cycle together?

problem: In PE, Kwame has already skipped 12 lengths of the hall, and the teacher asks for 9 more. What total number of lengths will he have skipped?
follow_up_questions: The hall is 25 metres long. How many metres will Kwame have skipped altogether?
His friend Esi skipped 4 fewer lengths than Kwame. How many lengths did Esi skip?
What is the total number of lengths Kwame and Esi skipped together?

problem: Pablo set 6 toy boats on the pond. His friends added some more boats. Altogether there are now 14 boats on the water. How many boats did his friends add?
follow_up_questions: Pablo lifts 5 of the boats out to take home. How many boats are still on the pond?
His friends put 3 more boats on the water. How many boats are on the pond now?
At the end, Pablo and his friend Kiri share the boats on the pond equally between the two of them. How many boats does each boy get?

problem: How many paper planes did the other children throw? Ines launched 6 paper planes across the classroom, and altogether 14 planes ended up on the floor.
follow_up_questions: Ines picks up 5 planes to put in her bag. How many planes are still on the floor?
The other children throw 3 more planes, which also land on the floor. How many planes are on the floor now?
Ines and her friend Sol split the planes on the floor equally between the two of them. How many planes does each girl get?

problem: When the ice rink opened, a few people began skating. The air was very cold. After 7 more skaters arrived, there were 16 people skating. How many were skating when the rink opened?
follow_up_questions: At noon, 5 skaters left the ice for hot chocolate. How many were still skating?

problem: How many players were on the tennis courts at opening time? Later 7 more players arrived, and then 16 people were playing. The nets had just been painted white.
follow_up_questions: At lunchtime, 5 players went home. How many were still playing?

problem: Mrs Nowak keeps a basket of found mittens by the classroom door. It had 13 mittens, and children brought her 5 more this week. How many mittens are in the basket now?
follow_up_questions: On Friday, owners came to collect 8 mittens. How many mittens are still in the basket?

problem: How many umbrellas are in the stand at the library now? There were 13 umbrellas, and 5 more were left behind by visitors today.
follow_up_questions: Before closing, 8 visitors came back for their umbrellas. How many umbrellas are still in the stand?

problem: There were 4 children waiting for the slide. A few more lined up behind them, so the line was 11 children long. The slide was shiny and silver. How many children joined the line?
How many shoppers joined the line at the bakery counter? At first it had 4 shoppers, and after the others came it was 11 long. The baker wore a tall white hat.
Mr Haddad's class hung 8 paper lanterns from the ceiling, next to the ones already hanging there. Now 19 lanterns are hanging. How many lanterns were hanging before the class added theirs?
follow_up_questions: At the end of the term, the class takes down 10 lanterns. How many are still hanging?

problem: There are now 19 boats tied up at the harbour after a fishing club sailed in with 8 boats. How many boats were tied up before the club arrived?
follow_up_questions: In the evening, 10 boats sail out to fish. How many boats are still tied up?

problem: The rabbit hutch at the farm had 15 rabbits. Last week, 4 baby rabbits were born. The farm also has 3 horses. How many rabbits are in the hutch now?
Find how many penguins live in the penguin house now. It had 15 penguins, and 4 chicks hatched there this spring. The keeper feeds them 3 times a day.
A cook dropped 9 dumplings into the pot, then tipped in a second bowl of dumplings. Now 17 dumplings are bubbling in the pot. How many dumplings were in the second bowl?
follow_up_questions: The family ate 12 of the dumplings. How many were left in the pot?

problem: How many seeds did Ana sprinkle from her second packet? She had already sprinkled 9 seeds from the first packet onto the bird tray, and now the tray has 17 seeds.
follow_up_questions: The birds peck up 12 of the seeds. How many seeds are left on the tray?

problem: Some people were already on the beach when a coach of 34 tourists arrived. That made 81 people on the beach. The sea was calm and blue. How many people were on the beach before the coach arrived?
Work out how many shoppers were already in the toy shop before a party of 34 children walked in, if there were then 81 people inside. The shop had a big train set in the window.
There are 13 ponies grazing in the paddock. The stable girl leads 6 more ponies out from the stable. How many ponies are in the paddock now?
follow_up_questions: Each pony gets 2 apples as a treat. How many apples are needed for all the ponies?

problem: At the pet shop, 13 guinea pigs were in the big pen when the owner carried in 6 more. What is the total number of guinea pigs in the pen?
follow_up_questions: Every guinea pig gets 2 lettuce leaves at dinner time. How many lettuce leaves are needed?

problem: At breakfast time, 16 boats were in the harbour. By lunch, more had sailed in and there were 24. How many boats sailed in?
follow_up_questions: In the evening, 9 boats sailed out to sea. How many stayed in the harbour?

problem: How many swans swam over to the pond during the day? In the morning Ms Yilmaz counted 16 swans, and by afternoon there were 24.
follow_up_questions: At dusk, 9 swans flew away. How many swans stayed on the pond?

problem: The school canteen got a delivery of 45 cartons of milk. After the delivery, it had 72 cartons. How many cartons did the canteen have before?
How many tennis balls did the sports shop have before a box of 45 arrived? After unpacking it, the shop had 72 tennis balls.
The farmer counted 56 sheep in the field. Then 27 sheep arrived from a nearby farm in 2 trailers. How many sheep are in the field now?
follow_up_questions: The field has room for 95 sheep. How many more sheep could still fit?
Next month the farmer will sell 18 of the sheep. How many sheep will be left in the field?

problem: What is the total number of books in the class library now? Mr Danso counted 56 books, and then a parent brought 27 more in 2 heavy bags.
follow_up_questions: The bookcase can hold 95 books. How many more books could still fit?
Next term Mr Danso will give 18 books to another class. How many books will be left in the class library?

problem: There were 38 people at the bakery window watching the cake decorator. Some more came to see her finish a wedding cake, and in all there were 63 people at the window. How many people came to see her finish the cake?
follow_up_questions: When the cake was done, 40 of the people walked away to do their shopping. How many people stayed at the window?

problem: How many children came to watch the magic show? Before it began, 38 children were sitting by the stage, and in all there were 63 when the magician started.
follow_up_questions: After the show, 40 of the children ran off to the bouncy castle. How many children stayed by the stage?

problem: A florist had 64 roses in her shop. A farmer brought her 29 more roses from his field. The new roses were deep pink. How many roses does the florist have now?
How many books are in the school library's adventure section after the librarian shelves 29 new books beside the 64 already there? The new books have shiny covers.
Her uncle bought Ana some badges at the castle shop, which brought her collection to 12 badges altogether. She already owned 7 badges. How many did her uncle buy?
follow_up_questions: She gives 3 badges to her best friend. How many badges does Ana keep?
At home, her mum gives her 3 badges from an old jacket. How many badges does Ana have now?
Ana pins her badges onto her bag in rows of 4. How many rows does she make?

problem: How many stickers did Pita's big sister give him? He had 7 dinosaur stickers, and now he has 12 altogether.
follow_up_questions: He gives 3 stickers to his friend. How many stickers does Pita keep?
Then his teacher gives him 3 stickers as a reward. How many stickers does Pita have now?
Pita puts his stickers on a page in rows of 4. How many rows does he fill?

problem: A group of people was watching the street juggler. When 8 more people walked over, the group grew to 17. The juggler had 40 balls in his bag. How big was the group before the others walked over?
follow_up_questions: Then 6 people walked on to the next stall. How many people are still watching the juggler?

problem: How many children were at the sandpit before the others came? When 8 more children ran over, there were 17 at the sandpit. The playground has 40 trees around it.
follow_up_questions: Then 6 of the children went to the swings. How many children are still at the sandpit?

problem: A farmer gave his horses 18 carrots in the morning. In the evening he gave them 7 more. How many carrots did the horses get that day?
Find how many pages Laila wrote in her diary this weekend: 18 on Saturday and another 7 on Sunday.
The garden centre had 26 rose bushes. After a new load came in, the manager counted 61. How many rose bushes were in the new load?
How many new stamps did Mrs Bianchi glue into her album? Before, it held 26 stamps, and now she counts 61.
On the day of the school play, 39 tickets were sold, bringing the total sold to 85. How many tickets had been sold before the day of the play?
follow_up_questions: The school hall has 90 seats. If every ticket holder comes, how many seats will be empty?
Just before the play starts, 3 more tickets are sold at the door. How many seats will be empty now?
How many people will watch the play if everyone with a ticket comes?

problem: How many children had signed up for the summer camp before the last day of sign-up? On that last day 39 more signed up, and the total reached 85.
follow_up_questions: The camp has 90 places. If every child who signed up comes, how many places will be empty?
On the first morning, 3 more children sign up at the gate. How many places are empty now?
How many children will be at the camp if everyone who signed up comes?

problem: At the farm, 6 children from another school joined Mr Lund's class. His class had left school that morning with 23 children. What is the size of the group now?
follow_up_questions: There are also 5 adults with the group. How many people is that in total?
The group splits into 2 equal teams to feed the animals. How many people are on each team?

problem: How many scouts are on the hike now? The troop left camp with 23 scouts, and 6 scouts from another troop joined them on the trail.
follow_up_questions: There are 5 leaders walking with them too. How many people are hiking altogether?
At the river, the hikers split into 2 equal groups. How many people are in each group?

problem: A bus driver set off on the tour with 21 tourists. At the castle, 8 more tourists asked to join the trip. How many tourists are on the bus after that?
follow_up_questions: At the end of the tour, 9 tourists got off at the market. How many tourists stayed on the bus?

problem: How many people are in the walking group now? The park ranger started her walk with 21 people, and 8 hikers joined at the waterfall.
follow_up_questions: At the car park, 9 people left to go home. How many people stayed with the ranger?

problem: The school library had 57 picture books. An author gave the library some more, and now it has 84 picture books. She had written them all herself. How many picture books did the author give?
follow_up_questions: The library puts 6 books on each shelf. How many shelves does it need for all the picture books?
Only 9 of those shelves fit in the reading room, and the rest go in the hallway. How many shelves go in the hallway?
How many picture books are on the hallway shelves?

problem: How many shells did the diver give the museum? Its shell collection grew from 57 shells to 84 after her gift. She had found them on a coral reef.
follow_up_questions: The museum puts 6 shells in each glass box. How many boxes does it need for the whole collection?
Only 9 boxes fit in the main hall; the rest go upstairs. How many boxes go upstairs?
How many shells are on show upstairs?

problem: For the spring fair, 36 flags were added to the ones already hanging in the school yard. Now 92 flags are hanging. The flags flap loudly in the wind. How many flags were hanging before the fair?
follow_up_questions: When the fair is over, 40 flags are taken down. How many flags are still hanging?

problem: How many photos were on the club's notice board before the trip? After the trip, the members pinned up 36 more, and now the board shows 92 photos. The notice board is made of cork.
follow_up_questions: A month later, 40 photos are taken off the board. How many photos stay on it?

problem: A delivery of 10 panda keyrings arrived at the zoo shop, where only 14 were left on the stand. How many panda keyrings does the shop have now?
follow_up_questions: Visitors bought 8 keyrings that afternoon. How many keyrings were on the stand at closing time?
The next morning, another 6 keyrings were sold. How many were still in the shop?

problem: How many jars of honey does the farm stall have now? It had only 14 jars left before the beekeeper brought 10 fresh jars.
follow_up_questions: Shoppers bought 8 jars that afternoon. How many jars did the stall have when it closed?
The next morning, 6 more jars were sold. How many jars were still on the stall?

problem: By noon on Saturday, 63 people had visited the swimming pool, and by closing time, 91 had. Find how many people came in the afternoon.
follow_up_questions: On Sunday, 15 more people came than on Saturday. How many people came on Sunday?
How many people visited the pool over the whole weekend?

problem: How many shoppers came to the farmers' market after midday on Saturday? The gate counter showed 63 at midday and 91 when the market closed.
follow_up_questions: On Sunday, 15 more shoppers came than on Saturday. How many shoppers came on Sunday?
What was the total number of shoppers over the two days?

problem: A jar on the teacher's desk held some marbles. A pupil gave her 9 more marbles, so the jar now holds 21. How many marbles were in the jar before the gift?
follow_up_questions: The teacher takes out 4 marbles for a maths game. How many marbles are left in the jar?
After the game she puts the 4 marbles back and adds 2 new ones. How many marbles are in the jar now?
How many more marbles are in the jar now than before the pupil's gift?

problem: How many dolls were on the toy museum shelf before a family gave 9 more? After the gift, the shelf holds 21 dolls.
follow_up_questions: A worker takes down 4 dolls to mend their dresses. How many dolls are left on the shelf?
She puts the 4 mended dolls back and adds 2 new ones. How many dolls are on the shelf now?
How many more dolls are on the shelf now than before the family's gift?

problem: The toy shop, which is 75 years old, had 35 rocking horses on show. For the holidays, 28 more were carried up from the cellar. How many rocking horses were on show during the holidays?
follow_up_questions: Each rocking horse has 4 legs. How many legs do the rocking horses on show have?
After the holidays, 30 rocking horses went back to the cellar. How many stayed on show?
How many legs do the rocking horses still on show have?

problem: How many kites hung from the shop ceiling during the summer? The shop normally hangs 35 kites, and for summer the owner brought out 28 more. The shop has been open for 75 years.
follow_up_questions: Each kite has 4 bows on its tail. How many bows are on the kites hanging up?
In autumn, 30 kites were taken down. How many kites stayed on the ceiling?
How many bows are on the kites still hanging up?

problem: Rosa had 46 marbles before the school fair. The fair gave prizes to each of the 25 children in her class, and Rosa ended up with 70 marbles. How many marbles did Rosa win at the fair?
follow_up_questions: She gives 15 marbles to her brother. How many marbles does she have left?
Her brother now has 32 marbles. How many more marbles does Rosa have than her brother?

problem: How many stamps did Tevita get at the post office open day? He had 46 stamps before, and now he has 70. The post office gave a gift bag to each of the 25 visitors.
follow_up_questions: He gives 15 stamps to his sister. How many stamps does Tevita have left?
His sister now has 32 stamps. How many more stamps does Tevita have than his sister?

problem: The train already had some passengers before the last station. At the last station, 27 more got on, and then there were 64 passengers on the train. How many passengers were on the train before the last station?
follow_up_questions: At the end of the line, all the passengers get off and walk out through 4 gates, the same number through each. How many passengers go through each gate?

problem: How many children were on the ferry before it stopped at the island? There, 27 children boarded, which made 64 children on the ferry.
follow_up_questions: At the harbour, all the children get off and line up in 4 equal rows. How many children are in each row?

problem: The tram had 15 riders. At the park stop, 9 more people stepped on. The driver smiled at everyone. How many riders were on the tram after the park stop?
follow_up_questions: At the next stop, 11 riders got off. How many were still on the tram?
Then 6 people got on at the museum. How many riders are there now?

problem: How many people were on the boat after it left the pier? There were 15 people aboard before the pier, and 9 more walked up the ramp there. The captain waved to each of them.
follow_up_questions: At the next pier, 11 people got off. How many were still aboard?
Then 6 people got on at the beach. How many people are aboard now?

problem: The guard counted 12 passengers in the first carriage when the train left the city. After the first station she counted 20. The carriage has 9 windows on each side. How many passengers got on at the first station?
follow_up_questions: At the next station, 5 passengers got off and 3 got on. How many passengers are in the carriage now?

problem: How many children got into the lift on the second floor? On the ground floor Mrs Ruiz counted 12 children in the lift, and after the second floor there were 20. The building has 9 floors.
follow_up_questions: On the next floor, 5 children got out and 3 got in. How many children are in the lift now?

problem: At the second stop, 10 shoppers boarded the tram and sat down, and then 18 seats were taken. The tram had green windows. How many seats were taken before that stop?
Find how many seats in the cinema were filled before the school group arrived. When the 10 children of the group sat down, 18 seats were filled. The cinema smelled of popcorn.
Kai counted 13 people in the train carriage. At the airport station, 7 more got on. The carriage has 40 seats. How many people are in the carriage now?
follow_up_questions: At the harbour station, 8 people get off. How many are still in the carriage?
Then 4 more get on. How many people are in the carriage?
How many fewer people are in the carriage now than just after the airport station?

problem: How many swimmers are in the pool now? Lifeguard Ben counted 13 swimmers, and then 7 more jumped in after their lesson. The pool is 40 metres long.
follow_up_questions: Then 8 swimmers climb out. How many are still in the pool?
After that, 4 more jump in. How many swimmers are in the pool?
How many fewer swimmers are in the pool now than just after the lesson ended?

problem: At the first stop, 6 people got on the empty ferry. More people got on at the second stop. When the ferry reached the island, 14 people were on board. The ferry is 25 metres long. How many people got on at the second stop?
follow_up_questions: On the way back, the same people ride the ferry, and 3 of them get off at the first stop. How many are still on board?
At the next stop, 5 more get off. How many people are left on the ferry?

problem: How many campers got into the minibus at the lake? The minibus was empty until 6 campers got in at the campsite, and when it reached the town after the lake there were 14 campers inside. The driver had driven 25 kilometres.
follow_up_questions: On the way home, the same campers ride back, and 3 of them get out at the first stop. How many are still in the minibus?
At the next stop, 5 more get out. How many campers are left in the minibus?

problem: A train stopped at a busy station, and 23 passengers got on. Then there were 51 passengers on the train. The station clock was very old. How many passengers were on the train before the station?
At the zoo gate, 23 visitors climbed onto the little zoo train, making 51 riders in all. The train was painted like a zebra. How many riders were on the train before the zoo gate?
A farmer unloads a crate of 32 melons onto her market stall, and now 50 melons are on display. Before the crate came, how many melons were on the stall?
follow_up_questions: During the busy morning, 47 melons were sold. How many were left?

problem: How many bowls of soup were on the school lunch counter before the cook brought out 32 more? After that, there were 50 bowls on the counter.
follow_up_questions: At lunchtime, the children took 47 bowls. How many bowls were left?

problem: Children lost 8 water bottles on the sports field on Tuesday, and the caretaker carried every one of them to the lost-and-found shelf. The shelf already had 11 bottles. How many bottles are on the shelf now?
How many hats are in the theatre's lost-and-found bin now? It held 11 hats, and after the Friday show the cleaners found 8 more hats that people had lost.
The ferry port has 4 ticket desks. At the busiest desk, 11 people were in line. Some more people joined, and then 19 people were in line. How many people joined the line?
follow_up_questions: The ferry that came in had 25 empty seats. After everyone in the line sat down, how many seats were still empty?

problem: How many children arrived at the bus stop? At first, 11 children were waiting at the stop, and later there were 19. The school has 4 buses.
follow_up_questions: The bus that came had 25 free seats. After all the waiting children sat down, how many free seats were left?

problem: After a farmer dropped off 15 bunches of tulips, the flower stall had 24 bunches. How many bunches of tulips were on the stall before the farmer came?
follow_up_questions: Shoppers bought 18 bunches before noon. How many bunches were left?

problem: Find how many comics were on the school library's comic shelf before the librarian put 15 new comics there. Now the shelf has 24 comics.
follow_up_questions: Pupils borrowed 18 comics before lunch. How many comics were left on the shelf?

problem: A long parade had 38 floats. At the town square, 24 more floats joined the line. How many floats were in the parade then?
follow_up_questions: If every float carries 5 musicians, how many musicians are in the parade?

problem: How many carriages long was the toy train after Mateo clipped on 24 more? It had 38 carriages before.
follow_up_questions: Each carriage holds 5 tiny toy animals. How many toy animals does the whole train carry?

problem: A park keeper had raked 5 bags of leaves before her 10-minute tea break. By the end of the day she had filled 13 bags. How many bags did she fill after her break?
follow_up_questions: Each bag weighs 3 kilograms. How many kilograms of leaves did she rake that whole day?
Another keeper raked 25 kilograms. How many kilograms did they rake together?

problem: How many boxes did the baker fill in the afternoon? By lunch she had filled 5 boxes of cookies, and by closing time 13. The bakery has 10 tables.
follow_up_questions: Each box holds 3 kilograms of cookies. How many kilograms of cookies did she pack all day?
Her helper packed 25 kilograms. How many kilograms did the two of them pack together?

problem: Squirrels were collecting nuts under the oak tree. Another 6 ran down from the branches, and then there were 15. How many squirrels were collecting nuts before the others came down?
follow_up_questions: A dog ran past and 10 squirrels raced away. How many were still collecting nuts?
Later, 7 squirrels came back. How many are collecting nuts now?
How many fewer squirrels are there now than just before the dog came?

problem: How many sparrows were hopping on the cafe terrace before 6 more flew down from the roof? After they landed, there were 15 sparrows on the terrace.
follow_up_questions: A waiter dropped a tray and 10 sparrows flew off. How many sparrows were still on the terrace?
Later, 7 sparrows came back. How many sparrows are on the terrace now?
How many fewer sparrows are there now than just before the tray fell?

problem: In the afternoon, 7 more yachts sailed into the marina and tied up beside the ones already there. That made 19 yachts in the marina. How many yachts were there before the afternoon?
follow_up_questions: Early the next morning, 11 yachts sailed out. How many yachts were still in the marina?
Then 3 yachts sailed in. How many are in the marina now?

problem: How many cars were in the garage before 7 more drove in at night? After they parked, there were 19 cars in the garage.
follow_up_questions: The next morning, 11 cars drove out. How many cars were still in the garage?
Then 3 cars came back. How many cars are in the garage now?

problem: The school canteen had 46 apples in a crate, and a farmer delivered 38 more. The canteen has 6 long tables. How many apples did the canteen have after the delivery?
follow_up_questions: By lunchtime the children had eaten 59 apples. How many were left?

problem: How many bottles of water did the stadium kiosk have after the morning delivery? There were 46 bottles in the fridge, and the van brought 38 more. The kiosk opens at 6 in the evening.
follow_up_questions: During the match, fans bought 59 bottles. How many bottles were left?

problem: Lina now owns 14 dinosaur cards. Before visiting the museum shop she had 6, and she spent her pocket money there on the rest. How many cards did she buy at the shop?
follow_up_questions: She gives 5 cards to her classmates. How many does she keep?
On the bus home, the driver gives her 2 more. How many dinosaur cards does she have now?

problem: How many bookmarks did Felipe buy at the book fair? He spent his savings there, and now he has 14 bookmarks, though he had only 6 before.
follow_up_questions: He mails 5 bookmarks to his cousins. How many does he keep?
At school, his teacher gives him 2 more. How many bookmarks does he have now?

problem: A queue formed outside the museum before it opened. After 8 more visitors joined, the queue had 20 visitors. How many visitors were in the queue to begin with?
follow_up_questions: The doors open and 9 visitors go in. How many are still waiting?
Then 6 more visitors go in. How many visitors are still outside?

problem: How many teams were at the sports field before 8 more teams arrived? Once they came, 20 teams were waiting for the tournament to start.
follow_up_questions: The first matches begin and 9 teams go onto the pitches. How many teams are still waiting?
Then 6 more teams are called to play. How many teams are still waiting at the side?

problem: Outside the supermarket, 23 shopping carts stood in a row. A worker collected 9 more from the car park and added them to the row. How many carts are in the row now?
follow_up_questions: Shoppers took 14 carts from the row. How many carts are still there?

problem: How many chairs are stacked by the hall door now? The caretaker stacked 23 chairs there in the morning and 9 more after lunch.
follow_up_questions: A class carried away 14 chairs for a meeting. How many chairs are still stacked?

problem: The scoreboard showed that 6 runners had finished the race. An hour later, 13 runners had finished. How many runners finished during that hour?
follow_up_questions: In the next hour, twice as many runners finished as in the hour before. How many runners finished in that next hour?

problem: How many letters did Saanvi write during the hour? Before the hour began she had written 6 letters, and by the end of it she had written 13.
follow_up_questions: In the following hour she wrote twice as many letters as in the hour before. How many letters did she write in that following hour?

problem: Before the fair, Nour made some paper flowers. Her mum made 24 more, and then they had 61 paper flowers. How many paper flowers did Nour make?
follow_up_questions: During the fair, 9 flowers got torn. How many flowers were left?
Nour handed the flowers that were left to visitors, 4 to each visitor. How many visitors got flowers?

problem: How many cupcakes did Theo bake for the bake sale, if his grandma baked 24 more and together they had 61 cupcakes?
follow_up_questions: On the way, 9 cupcakes got squashed. How many cupcakes were left?
Theo packed the cupcakes that were left into boxes of 4. How many boxes did he fill?

problem: There were fewer name tags than guests: Aditi had only 12 ready. So her teacher made 6 more. How many name tags are there now?
How many sandbags are ready now? The workers had filled 12, but the captain said that was fewer than they needed, so they filled 6 more.
There were 7 cards on the shelf when the wedding party began. More guests arrived with cards, and soon there were 16. The band played all night. How many cards did the later guests bring?
follow_up_questions: The bride opened 10 cards before dinner. How many cards were still sealed?
After dinner she opened 4 more. How many are still sealed?

problem: How many gifts did the late guests bring to the baby shower? When it started, 7 gifts sat on the table, and after more guests came there were 16. Everyone laughed at the funny games.
follow_up_questions: The mother opened 10 gifts before the tea was served. How many gifts were still wrapped?
After tea she opened 4 more. How many gifts are still wrapped?

problem: Grandad added 8 sausages to the grill, and the grill then had 20 sausages on it. Mia was turning 7 that day. How many sausages were on the grill before Grandad added his?
follow_up_questions: The guests ate 15 sausages. How many were left?

problem: How many sandwiches were on the tray before Aunt Lola put on 8 more? After that the tray held 20 sandwiches. The party was for Ben's 7th birthday.
follow_up_questions: The children ate 15 sandwiches. How many were left on the tray?

problem: In the gym, 9 children were skipping rope. Then 6 more started skipping. The gym has 5 windows. How many children were skipping then?
follow_up_questions: Then 4 children stopped to drink water. How many were still skipping?
When the music came on, 7 more children started skipping. How many children are skipping now?
The children who are skipping get into pairs. How many pairs are there?

problem: How many skaters were on the ice after 6 more stepped on? There were 9 skaters to start with. The rink had been open for 5 hours.
follow_up_questions: Then 4 skaters left the ice to rest. How many were still skating?
When the next song started, 7 more skaters came on. How many skaters are on the ice now?
The skaters on the ice hold hands in pairs. How many pairs are there?

problem: By the end of the afternoon, 18 children were at the class picnic. Only 11 had been there when it started; the rest came after their swimming lesson. How many children came after swimming?
follow_up_questions: Each child gets 2 sandwiches. How many sandwiches are needed?
Each loaf makes 6 sandwiches. How many loaves are needed?

problem: How many guests came to the sleepover late? At first there were 11 guests, and by bedtime there were 18.
follow_up_questions: Each guest gets 2 pancakes for breakfast. How many pancakes are needed?
One batch of batter makes 6 pancakes. How many batches are needed?

problem: Auntie Ama poured 35 more beads into the craft box, making 82 beads inside. How many beads were in the box before?
follow_up_questions: When the box tipped over, the children picked up all the beads except 10 that rolled under the table. How many beads did the children pick up?
They shared those beads equally among 8 children. How many beads did each child get?

problem: How many conkers were in the bucket before Jack tipped in 35 more? After that, there were 82 conkers in the bucket.
follow_up_questions: Jack's friends took all the conkers except 10 to play a game. How many conkers did they take?
The conkers they took were shared equally among 8 friends. How many conkers did each friend get?

problem: The gym had 48 mats laid out for the yoga class. Another 36 mats were rolled out when more people came. The gym has 4 doors. How many mats were laid out in the end?
follow_up_questions: Only 79 people came. How many mats were empty?

problem: How many plates were on the tables at the wedding by the end? The caterers set out 48 plates, then carried in another 36 when more guests turned up. The cake had 4 layers.
follow_up_questions: Only 79 guests came to eat. How many plates were not used?

problem: Bruno had planted 8 bean seeds in pots. He planted some more on Sunday, and now there are 15 bean seeds in the pots. His dog barked at the birds all morning. How many seeds did he plant on Sunday?
follow_up_questions: In the spring, only 12 of the seeds grew into bean plants. How many seeds did not grow?
Bruno gave 5 of the bean plants to his neighbour. How many bean plants are still growing in his pots?
He then bought 6 bean plants from the market. How many bean plants are growing now?

problem: How many daffodil bulbs did Sakura plant on Sunday? She had already planted 8 in the school garden, and after Sunday there were 15 bulbs. The garden gate creaked in the wind.
follow_up_questions: Only 12 bulbs came up as daffodils. How many bulbs did not come up?
Sakura cut 5 of the daffodils for her teacher. How many daffodils are still growing?
Then she planted 6 daffodil plants from the garden centre. How many daffodils are growing now?

problem: Along the river path there were 54 trees. On a planting day, volunteers added 38 young trees. How many trees line the path now?
follow_up_questions: A strong wind blew down 17 trees. How many were still standing?

problem: How many tulips are in the park's flower bed now? It had 54 tulips, and the gardeners planted 38 more.
follow_up_questions: Rabbits nibbled 17 of the tulips down to the ground. How many tulips are still standing?

problem: Altogether, Mrs Rahman picked 56 apples from her tree over the weekend. On Saturday she picked 29. How many apples did she pick on Sunday?
follow_up_questions: She gave 18 apples to her friends. How many apples did she keep?
She used 8 apples for a pie and the rest for apple juice. How many apples went into the juice?

problem: How many eggs did Farmer Obi collect on Thursday? On Wednesday he collected 29 eggs, and altogether over the two days he collected 56.
follow_up_questions: He sold 18 eggs at the market. How many eggs did he keep?
He used 8 eggs for breakfast and the rest for baking. How many eggs went into the baking?

problem: Some butterflies were resting on the lavender. Then 7 more fluttered down, and now there are 16. How many butterflies were resting on the lavender at first?
follow_up_questions: Then 4 butterflies flew off. How many are on the lavender now?

problem: How many boats were on the lake before 7 more rowed out from the shore? Now there are 16 boats on the lake.
follow_up_questions: Then 4 boats came back to the shore. How many boats are on the lake now?

problem: Kwasi had 13 balls of wool left after knitting his scarf. His grandma gave him 7 more balls. How many balls of wool does Kwasi have now?
follow_up_questions: He uses 8 balls of wool to knit a hat. How many balls does he have left?
He shares the balls he has left equally with his sister, so the two of them get the same amount. How many balls of wool does each of them get?

problem: How many paint tubes does Lior have now? After painting her picture she had 13 tubes left, and then her art teacher gave her 7 more.
follow_up_questions: She uses up 8 tubes on a big poster. How many tubes does she have left?
She shares her leftover tubes equally with her friend, so both of them have the same number. How many tubes does each girl get?

problem: The art room cupboard held 34 paint pots. After a large gift from a shop, the cupboard held 81 pots in total. How many pots did the shop give?
follow_up_questions: The class uses 25 of the pots to mix paint. How many pots are still unused?
The unused pots are stacked in towers of 8. How many towers are there?

problem: How many crates did the market traders donate to the food bank? It had 34 crates, and after the donation it had 81 crates in total.
follow_up_questions: Volunteers fill 25 crates with food parcels. How many crates are still empty?
The empty crates are stacked in piles of 8. How many piles are there?

problem: Amira's basket holds 21 eggs now. She added the last 9 after a second trip to the hen house. How many eggs did she collect on her first trip?
follow_up_questions: She drops 3 eggs on the way to the kitchen and they break. How many eggs are left in the basket?
She shares them equally among 3 neighbours. How many eggs does each neighbour get?
One neighbour buys 2 more eggs from the shop. How many eggs does that neighbour have now?

problem: How many blackberries did Rafa pick before lunch? After lunch he picked 9 more, and his tub then held 21 blackberries.
follow_up_questions: Rafa ate 3 of them. How many are left in the tub?
He shares the blackberries equally among 3 cousins. How many does each cousin get?
One cousin finds 2 more on the bush. How many blackberries does that cousin have now?

problem: At dawn, 6 ducks were on the farm pond. By lunchtime there were 14. How many ducks had come to the pond?
follow_up_questions: A tractor rumbled past and 9 ducks flew off. How many ducks stayed on the pond?
Later, 3 of those ducks waddled to the barn. How many ducks are left on the pond?

problem: How many children joined the reading corner after the bell? Before it rang, 6 children were reading there, and after it rang there were 14.
follow_up_questions: The teacher called 9 children to the art table. How many children stayed in the reading corner?
Later, 3 of them went to the computer desk. How many children are left in the reading corner?

problem: Altogether, 93 potatoes are now in the kitchen box, after the cook tipped in 47 more. How many potatoes were in the box at first?
follow_up_questions: The potatoes are packed into sacks of 3. How many sacks are filled?
Each sack sells for 2 dollars. How much money do the sacks bring in?

problem: How many apples were in the barrel before the pickers added 47 more? After they did, the barrel held 93 apples altogether.
follow_up_questions: The apples are sold in packs of 3. How many packs can be made?
Each pack costs 2 dollars. How many dollars do all the packs bring in?

problem: Darius had caught 15 fish when his uncle gave him another 7. How many fish does Darius have now?
follow_up_questions: He gives 10 fish to his neighbours. How many fish does he keep?

problem: Find the number of shells in Leilani's bucket. She had collected 15 shells on the beach, and then her grandfather dropped in another 7.
follow_up_questions: Leilani gives 10 shells to her friends. How many shells does she keep?

problem: The park gardener now looks after 20 rose bushes. Only 12 were there before he planted some new ones in spring. How many new bushes did he plant?
follow_up_questions: Each new bush needs 2 canes for support. How many canes does the gardener need for the new bushes?
He already has 5 canes. How many more canes must he buy?

problem: How many new tomato plants did Mrs Ogundipe put in her greenhouse? There were 12 plants before, and there are 20 now.
follow_up_questions: Each new plant needs 2 sticks to climb. How many sticks does she need for the new plants?
She has 5 sticks in her shed. How many more sticks must she buy?

problem: There were 23 butterflies on the lavender bush after 9 more fluttered over from 2 nearby gardens. How many butterflies were on the bush before the newcomers arrived?
How many ants were on the picnic blanket at first? Then 9 more crawled over from the 2 ant hills by the tree, and Ella counted 23 ants on the blanket.
Granny had 18 knitted hats in her drawer. She knitted 6 more over the winter. Her cat liked to play with the wool. How many hats are in the drawer now?
follow_up_questions: She gives 10 hats to the school fair. How many hats are left?
She keeps 2 hats for herself and gives the rest equally to her 3 grandchildren. How many hats does each grandchild get?

problem: How many loaves are on the bakery shelf now? The baker had 18 loaves there and baked 6 more this morning. The whole street smelled of warm bread.
follow_up_questions: He sends 10 loaves to the school kitchen. How many loaves are left?
He keeps 2 loaves for his family and gives the rest equally to his 3 neighbours. How many loaves does each neighbour get?

problem: The vase held only 8 flowers, fewer than Mum liked. She added 5 more flowers from the garden. How many flowers were in the vase then?
How many candles were on the cake after Leo pushed in 5 more? At first there were 8 candles, fewer than his sister wanted.
The teacher had collected 37 leaves for the art project. The pupils brought more, and the pile grew to 64 leaves. How many leaves did the pupils bring?
follow_up_questions: They used 45 leaves on the first day. How many leaves were left?
The next morning the pupils gathered 28 more. How many leaves were in the pile then?
On the second day they used all but 9 leaves. How many leaves did they use that day?

problem: How many sandbags did the volunteers fill? The fire chief had filled 37 sandbags, and with the volunteers' help the stack reached 64.
follow_up_questions: They placed 45 sandbags along the river bank on the first day. How many sandbags were left in the stack?
The next morning, 28 more were filled. How many sandbags were in the stack then?
On the second day they placed all but 9 sandbags. How many did they place that day?

problem: At the picnic, a friend gave Zoe 7 grapes. After that, Zoe's lunch box held 19 grapes. How many grapes were in the lunch box before?
follow_up_questions: Zoe ate 11 grapes. How many are left in the lunch box?

problem: How many crayons were in Arjun's tin before his classmate gave him 7? Now the tin holds 19 crayons.
follow_up_questions: Arjun lends 11 crayons to his table. How many crayons are left in the tin?

problem: How many photos did the family take at the zoo? They took 9 in the morning and another 8 in the afternoon.
In the morning the bakers iced 9 cakes, and before closing time they iced 8 more. Find the total number of cakes they iced.
Omar's class had found 7 feathers on the walk to the park. By the time they reached the pond, 3 streets away, they had 15 feathers. How many feathers did they find on the way to the pond?
